question: In 1705, which scientist published 'A Synopsis of the Astronomy of Comets', which described the parabolic orbits of 24 comets that were observed from 1337 to 1698?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Edmund Halley".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Edmund was an English **astronomer.**
 
• He was the first person who calculated the **orbit of a comet.**
 
• He showed the distribution of prevailing winds over the ocean.
 
• He published** 'A synopsis of the astronomy of comets' in 1705**.
 
• In this discovery, he showed that three comets of **1531, 1607, and 1682 **had similar characteristics and these are now known as **Halley's Comet.**
 
• He also discovered the method for observing transits of Venus across the Sun in 1716.
